ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Liftria uses the camera only when you take a meal photo for a Hiku estimate.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Liftria opens your photos only when you choose a meal photo for a Hiku estimate.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Liftria reads steps, heart rate, workouts, sleep and body measurements from Apple Health to show them in the app. It never writes to Apple Health.
